hypothesis: Rank-shift JSD retains more base-model capability than Dr.GRPO at matched training exposure while preserving GSM8K plasticity.

claim_scope.reason: Existing JSD and Dr.GRPO recipes differ in optimizer beta1, responses per prompt, and update epochs as well as objective.

confirmatory_loss_function_claim_require.only_intended_difference: rank-shift JSD versus Dr.GRPO objective/advantage construction

primary_endpoint.name: retention_auc_difference_in_differences
primary_endpoint.definition: Weighted macro accuracy delta from base, integrated over matched training exposure; JSD minus Dr.GRPO.
primary_endpoint.confidence_interval: paired hierarchical bootstrap over tasks and shared item IDs

reporting_rules: Report every registered model and task, including failed parses and missing runs.
Never label a best-model export as a later recovery step.
Do not include GSM8K or other training-domain tasks in the forgetting aggregate.
Report absolute accuracy, base-relative delta, relative retention, and confidence intervals.
A less-forgetting claim requires a positive primary JSD-minus-Dr.GRPO confidence interval and non-inferior GSM8K plasticity under a separately declared margin.
Single-seed results are exploratory and cannot support a broad algorithm-level claim without replication.
